stemMd:
The team expected the new route to be shorter. It was, ______ the steep final section made the journey take longer than the old route had.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The existing comma plus the coordinating conjunction but correctly joins the independent clauses. Conjunctive adverbs such as however require stronger punctuation between the clauses.

distractorRationale.c: Nevertheless cannot substitute for a conjunction at this comma boundary.
distractorRationale.d: However cannot join two independent clauses with only surrounding commas.
distractorRationale.a: Therefore is not a coordinating conjunction and would also misstate the relationship.
